what: Thumb-to-screen latency budget per stage (P1-FL17, R134), checked by web/tests/journeys/fl17-latency.test.mjs. hostSide holds on every CI host, software-rendered or not (ms): mainToWorker is a postMessage, workerToTick may wait for at most one 120 Hz tick boundary plus the worker's 2 ms loop, so p99 under two ticks. hostSideGpu adds the render stages and holds only with a real GPU (JJ_CHROMIUM_GPU=1, the CI GPU workflow on eris): renderLagTicks is how far the drawn tick trails the newest snapshot, in 120 Hz ticks (the interpolation delay plus at most a frame). wholePath is the target for a real run on the owner's LAN, recorded in docs/evidence/P1-FL17/.
